def test_ac4_structured_claim_detail_fields_are_required(html):
    """US-1-AC4: the employment and absence information intake needs."""
    required_fields = {
        "last-day-worked": "lastDayWorked",
        "first-day-absent": "firstDayAbsent",
        "nature-of-absence": "natureOfAbsence",
        "claim-details": "claimDetails",
    }
    for element_id, field_name in required_fields.items():
        assert _has_id(html, element_id), f"missing #{element_id}"
        tag = re.search(
            r"<(?:input|select|textarea) id='%s'[^>]*>" % re.escape(element_id), html
        )
        assert tag is not None, f"#{element_id} tag not found"
        assert "name='%s'" % field_name in tag.group(0)
        assert "required" in tag.group(0), f"#{element_id} is not required"

    # Expected return is optional by design, but must still be capturable.
    assert _has_id(html, "expected-return")

    # Nature of absence offers structured options rather than free text.
    select_block = html[html.index("<select id='nature-of-absence'"):]
    select_block = select_block[: select_block.index("</select>")]
    assert select_block.count("<option") >= 5
